title: Activation safeguards and initiative tide for Private VPC waves
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Objective: Define and sequence the quarterly activation plan for customer-hosted Private/VPC deployments with prescriptive safeguards. This ticket consolidates operator rituals, preflight checks, roll-forward/rollback gates, and OKR-linked success signals so that waves of customers can be activated with minimal incident risk and clear escalation paths. Scope includes: canary cohort definitions, compatibility verifier checklist, upgrade window taxonomy, automated gating logic, runbooks for failed activations, and telemetry signals that feed the Console activation dashboard.
acceptance_criteria: 1) A documented activation choreography describing wave cadence, canary criteria, and safety gates is approved by Eng and Security. 2) Preflight compatibility verifier spec and a reference script are merged to the private-infra repo. 3) Console shows an 'activation health' panel with the baseline signals (errors/sec, P95 latency, auth failures). 4) Runbooks for abort/rollback and an automated rollback circuit are drafted and validated in a staging wave. 5) OKR metrics and cohort targets are captured in the project board and linked to rollout milestones.

risks: Installer/driver incompatibilities across customer hardware causing wave delays
KMS/HSM integration edge cases delaying canary sign-offs
Insufficient telemetry coverage for early detection of regressions
Customer onboarding windows conflict with their maintenance cycles
